text:
```yaml
name: Validate Model

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo install cargo-make

    - name: Run validation scripts
      run: |
        make -C default-model validate
        python3 default-model/scripts/validate.py
        cargo test --lib

    - name: Build akaza-data
      run: |
        make -C akaza-data

    - name: Evaluate model
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        make -C default-model evaluate
```
